title: 委員たちの井戸端会議

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In the interest of promoting amity between the academy's various committees, it has been suggested that we hold a competitive relay race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What's unique about this relay is that the batons carried by the runners will be replaced with items related to each committee.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Umm… So, for example, you mean the library committee members might run with a book?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's right. What about the other committees? Do you have any ideas about what you could use for a baton?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I suppose the health committee could use a thermometer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Maybe the groundskeeping committee could use a dust cloth? Oh, but a broom would work nicely too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hm, then perhaps a laptop would be suitable for the general affairs committee.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! A-are you sure about that? Wouldn't it be really bad if you dropped it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I envisioned that a mishap like that could occur, so I plan to use a model that can withstand drops from heights of up to ten meters.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-wow! I didn't know there were laptops that durable!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The disciplinary committee will use a bamboo sword! A pure, honorable sword that will subdue any who dare to disturb the peace.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However, I worry that sprinting around while brandishing a sword could itself be easily misconstrued as an act that disturbs the peace…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wha?! …Geez, if that's the case, then what else can we use for the baton?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now, now, let's not worry. We can all think of something together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While passing through the central plaza, I spot Symboli Rudolf and others discussing potential baton candidates.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What kind of work does the disciplinary committee usually do?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We keep a watchful eye on Golshi to make sure she doesn't do anything weird!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The gratitude I harbor for your service cannot be expressed in words.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We also greet students when they arrive in the morning, warn them about violating the dress code, and patrol the academy in case anyone breaks curfew!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That all sounds very important, but I'm not sure any of those duties involve anything especially baton-like.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, we also make any student who breaks academy rules write up an apology statement!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: What if the disciplinary committee members carry an apology statement as they run?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa! Wouldn't that make it seem like we did something bad?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: How about if we write "THIS ISN'T AN APOLOGY STATEMENT" in really big letters?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's just gonna make it look even more suspicious! It'll seem like we're making excuses!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I think we need some fresh ideas. In which case…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What about you? What do you think would serve as a suitable baton to symbolize the disciplinary committee?
choice_data_list: What if you have Gold Ship run alongside them?
Let's use their "conviction" to discipline as the baton!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We wouldn't even have something to hold! And who knows if Golshi would actually show up!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is Golshi we're talking about…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, she's certainly not one to be tied down by obligations.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She always does something completely different from what we expect!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It'd be great if we all put our heads together and come up with a way to stop her from doing that!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That could very well be an insurmountable task…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The topic of how to curb Gold Ship's behavior gradually shifts to the forefront of the discussion, and the baton issue is left by the wayside.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Conviction?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! I see what you're getting at! Our members all have that same conviction lying deep in our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But will onlookers be able to tell whether you've passed that to the next runner?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We could write "conviction" on some cardboard and use that as the baton!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait a second! Plain old cardboard doesn't convey the conviction of the disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm… If cardboard's no good, what about washi paper?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the discussion about how to convert the concept of "conviction" into a baton continues.
